description: An absolute CDN stylesheet answers 404: critical silently drops it.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on another host (CDN / third party) is skipped with one logSafe'd warning and the job succeeds. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
